records.source_statement: When frustrating planet rules second house Lilly attributes hindrance to lack of money, portion or dowry.
limitations: Obstruction by the SECOND lord, not friendly translation of light.

records.source_statement: Third-house ruler causing hindrance is interpreted as querent's siblings, relatives, neighbour or short journey.
limitations: This is one bundle of alternatives; not all happen together.

records.source_statement: Fourth lord obstruction is read as refusal by a parent, land, houses, tenements or inability to settle an estate.
limitations: The parent role and property contexts are alternatives.

records.source_statement: Fifth-house obstruction can concern children, possible infertility, earlier child out of wedlock or an objection about anticipated pleasure and luxuries.
limitations: Printed author speculates; not medical proof of fertility or character.

records.source_statement: Sixth-house ruler as impediment suggests uncle/servant or infirmity/sickness of querent.
limitations: A conjectured cause, not clinical diagnosis.

records.source_statement: A planet in seventh might point to another friend, public enemy, earlier quarrel or lawsuit hindering the match.
limitations: Several possible social categories, not proven accusations.
